title: Drift Wood #32 · the red pen
logline: Chloe proofs the drawing, not the text. Seattle, said sideways.

panels.composition: The newsroom after hours. Two desks pushed together under one lamp. WOOD inks a strip; CHLOE proofs his page with a red pen she is using on the drawing, not the text. A dark window behind them.

characters.pose: red pen on his page, leaning in

image.prompt: two teenagers at desks pushed together in a dark school newsroom under one desk lamp, a boy inking a comic page, a girl with heavy eyeliner marking his drawing with a red pen, black window behind

panels.composition: Over Chloe's shoulder onto the page: the six-fingered cashier, circled in red.

balloons.text: —had the correct number of fingers and drew them wrong on purpose. You drew this one wrong by accident and now you're citing Vienna.

image.prompt: over-the-shoulder close-up of a red pen circling a crudely drawn six-fingered hand on a comic page under lamp light

panels.composition: Silence. Wood, deadpan, adding a seventh finger.

characters.pose: pen to page, adding a finger

image.prompt: a teenage boy at a desk deliberately adding another finger to a drawing while a girl beside him watches unreadably, desk lamp, deep black shadows
image.notes: No balloons. The beat is the pen.

panels.composition: The two desks and the dark window, mostly. Both heads down, both pens moving.
